review:
Sumo Supreme Megaways is a Japanese wrestling slot on Megaways reels with tumbles. Instant-pay symbols add their value to any winning combination they join.

Every symbol and reel is given a random weight. When the symbols on a reel weigh as much as or more than the reel's weight, a special symbol is awarded, and each cascade lowers the reel's weight by one, making special symbols more likely as tumbles continue. The RTP is 96.55%, and Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on the page. The weight mechanic is one of the more original ideas in the studio's recent catalogue.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
